display_name: Crisis 2028: Second Thomas Shoal Littoral Clash & USV Swarms
era_label: 2028 Littoral Gray-Zone to High-End Naval War
briefing_opord: OPORD 28-103: Gray-zone escalation escalates into open combat around Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal. Chinese Maritime Militia and CCG vessels backed by Type 055 guided-missile cruisers attempt to seize BRP Sierra Madre. Allied US-Philippine task forces deploy MAGURA V5 autonomous strike USVs, MQ-28 Ghost Bat combat drones, and F-35A BVR air overwatch to maintain freedom of navigation.
key_features: BVR Air Cover & Combat Air Patrol (CAP)
